Name: Huram, the Craftsman
Summary: Huram, a cunning man endued with understanding, was sent by the king of Tyre to Solomon; he made the temple's bronze vessels, including the pots, shovels, basins, pillars and sea.
KeyStory: Huram finished the bronze work for the house of God, and made all its instruments of bright brass for King Solomon.
RelatedPeople: King Solomon; Hiram, King of Tyre
LifeLesson: God-given skill, used for His house, is itself a form of service.
